Hi Samantha — great to hear from you, and thanks for the questions.

Short answers:
- Legal entity: please use the exact legal name that appears on the W-9. If that's "Helix Instruments, Inc." we'll use that as the vendor master name; if it's the LLC, we'll record the subsidiary and note the parent in the "doing business as" field.
- Remit: our standard practice is to have invoices sent to invoices@redwood.ai for automated ingestion, but we can route them to accounts@helixinstruments.com if you prefer receiving confirmations directly. Which would you like?
- Vendor fields: our onboarding form includes tax id/EIN, remit address, ACH details (bank name, routing, account last4), primary billing contact, and PO email. There are checkboxes for "public sector" and currency override — leave them blank unless applicable.

I'm attaching the Redwood vendor onboarding PDF and a one-page PO routing template that our procurement team prefers. Please fill out the vendor onboarding form and return with your signed W-9 and bank remittance instructions. If you prefer to sign electronically we can send a DocuSign link.

Proposed next steps:
1) You complete and return the attached form + W-9 + remit instructions.
2) I'll open the vendor file with Finance (cc'd Karthik) and request vendor master creation in our ERP.
3) Finance will provide a vendor ID; once created we can issue the first PO.

If that all works, please send the completed package.

Best,
